newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Caspian to launch $25-50 mln Ukraine invest fund.
newsitem.headline: Caspian to launch $25-50 mln Ukraine invest fund.

text.p: Caspian, the London-based fund management group, plans to launch a $25-50 million investment fund with a Ukrainian finance and investment company in March, a senior Caspian official said on Monday.

"At this time we cannot name an exact sum for our fund, because talks with investors are continuing. We estimate it to be $25-50 million," James Churm, The Caspian Group's fund asset manager, told a news conference.
Churm said the fund planned to register in March and would invest in equities and participate in trading on the Ukrainian Stock Exchange and at privatisation certificate auctions.
Companies in the oil and gas, metals, chemical and energy sectors held most interest for investors, he said.
"We want to take advantage of the privatisation process in 1997," Churm said.
Ukraine plans to move ahead significantly with large-scale privatisation this year.
Regent Pacific Group has also announced the planned launch of a $50 million Ukraine investment fund.
